# anthropic_plugins (Data Source)

Lists the organization's plugins through the Plugins API beta `ce-plugins-2026-09-01`, with optional filters.

The Plugins API is available only to Claude Enterprise organizations. It
accepts an API key created in claude.ai under Organization settings > API
(`sk-ant-api01-...`) with the `read:plugins` scope, not an Admin API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_plugins" "engineering_tools" {
  provider       = anthropic.plugins
  marketplace_id = "marketplace_01VbNcMxZaSdFgHjKlQwErTy"
  owner_type     = "organization"
}

output "plugins_inheriting_the_marketplace_default" {
  value = [
    for plugin in data.anthropic_plugins.engineering_tools.plugins :
    plugin.name
    if plugin.organization_installation_preference_inherited
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_at_gt` (String) Only plugins created after this RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `created_at_gte` (String) Only plugins created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `created_at_lt` (String) Only plugins created before this RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `created_at_lte` (String) Only plugins created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `marketplace_id` (String) Only plugins in this marketplace. An ID that matches no marketplace returns no plugins.
- `owner_type` (String) Only plugins with this owner type: `organization` or `user`.
- `owner_user_id` (String) Only plugins owned by this member.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source, derived from the configured filters.
- `plugins` (Attributes List) The matching plugins, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins))

<a id="nestedatt--plugins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins`

Read-Only:

- `components` (Attributes List) What the served version contains. Null when not enumerated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins--components))
- `content_scan` (Attributes) The served version's content scan. Null when it has not been scanned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins--content_scan))
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the plugin was created.
- `created_by` (Attributes) Who created the plugin. Null when no creator is recorded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins--created_by))
- `description` (String) The served version's description. Null when empty.
- `display_name` (String) The served version's display name.
- `id` (String) ID of the plugin.
- `latest_version_id` (String) ID of the newest version.
- `manifest_version` (String) The served version's manifest `version`, normalized for display. Null when it has none.
- `marketplace_id` (String) ID of the marketplace the plugin lives in.
- `name` (String) Lowercase identifier, unique within its marketplace.
- `organization_installation_preference` (String) The organization-wide installation setting of an organization-owned plugin: its own setting, or its marketplace's default. Null for a member-owned plugin.
- `organization_installation_preference_inherited` (Boolean) True while `organization_installation_preference` is the marketplace's default. Null for a member-owned plugin.
- `owner` (Attributes) Who owns the plugin: the organization, or the member whose personal marketplace it lives in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plugins--owner))
- `reach` (String) How far the served version reaches: `contained`, `privileged` or `remote`. Null when not classified.
- `served_version_id` (String) ID of the version claude.ai serves to members.
- `served_version_pinned` (Boolean) False while the served version follows each new version; true once it has been pinned to one.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last new version or served-version change. Installation settings do not move it.

<a id="nestedatt--plugins--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins.components`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the component. Null when empty.
- `name` (String) Name of the component.
- `type` (String) Component type, for example `skill` or `mcp_server`.


<a id="nestedatt--plugins--content_scan"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins.content_scan`

Read-Only:

- `assessment` (String) Assessment of the scan. Null when the API returns none.
- `reason` (String) Reason for the assessment. Null when the API returns none.
- `status` (String) Status of the scan.


<a id="nestedatt--plugins--created_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins.created_by`

Read-Only:

- `api_key_id` (String) ID of the API key that created the plugin. Null unless `type` is `api_actor`.
- `email_address` (String) Email address of the member who created the plugin. Null unless `type` is `user_actor`.
- `type` (String) Creator type: `user_actor` or `api_actor`.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the member who created the plugin. Null unless `type` is `user_actor`.


<a id="nestedatt--plugins--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plugins.owner`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Owner type: `organization` or `user`.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the member who owns the plugin. Null unless `type` is `user`.
